citations.excerpt: Addition of either CSF2 or DKK1 lowered pregnancy rate for cows receiving embryos cultured in no serum but there was no additional reduction in pregnancy rate due to CSF2 or DKK1 for cows receiving embryos cultured in SR or FBS. In fact, CSF2 increased pregnancy rate for embryos cultured in serum (96/196; 49.0% for CSF2 vs 54/138; 39.1% for vehicle).
